name: Verizon Fios & Verizon Home Internet (Fios, 5G Home, LTE Home)
notes: Researched from public verizon.com residential support pages only (no sign-in). My Verizon sign-in: enter a User ID or 10-digit Verizon mobile number, select Continue, then Sign in with password or Send to device (approve a notification on a verified, text-capable phone within 3 minutes); the device approval is modelled as SMS verification (inferred). Payments: Pay bill under Home or Bills in My Verizon, or the Make a one-time payment link from the sign-in menu (lookup fields not described, family default kept). Methods: checking/savings (Online Banking via Trustly), debit/credit card; scheduled payments are debited on the chosen date; same-day payments can be cancelled up to 2 times per 90 days. Auto Pay (Set Up Auto Pay, pick a calendar day, Enroll) accepts bank, debit, credit or Verizon Visa Card; the allowed day range is not published (family default kept). Auto Pay discount: $10/month with select Fios Internet plans, $10 with Fios TV, $20 with both, only with a bank account or Verizon Visa Card plus paper-free billing (debit-card enrollments before 8/13/25 grandfathered). Payment arrangements split a past-due amount into two payments; free online or through the automated line, $7 Agent Assistance Fee with a representative; late charges still apply. Disconnecting Fios is not a self-service form: My Verizon Settings & profile > Disconnect opens a chat with a representative, or call 1-800-VERIZON; rented equipment back within 30 days; early termination fee prorated, capped at $350, dropping $15 a month. cancel_service is therefore unsupported (no self-service). Plan prices on the public Fios page show inconsistent was/now figures and are left out. 5G Home is billed in My Verizon on the wireless side; the Fios rules are modelled.

help.title: Fios Auto Pay and the Auto Pay discount
paragraphs: In My Verizon, open Set Up Auto Pay, choose a payment method, pick the day of the month from the calendar, review it, select Enroll and accept the terms. Keep paying your bill until the first automatic payment is taken. You can change the date later under Manage Auto Pay.

Auto Pay accepts a bank account, debit card, credit card or Verizon Visa Card. The monthly discount needs a bank account or Verizon Visa Card plus paper-free billing: $10 a month with select Fios Internet plans, $10 with Fios TV, or $20 with both. Debit cards enrolled before 8/13/25 keep the discount.
To opt out, go to Bill, then Auto Pay, and follow the prompts.
steps: Choose a payment method and a day of the month.
Select Enroll and accept the terms.

help.title: Payment arrangements
paragraphs: You can split a past-due amount into two payments from the payment arrangement page in My Verizon or in the app (Me, Home, Bill overview, Payment Arrangements).

Arrangements made online or through the automated phone system are free. If a representative sets it up by phone, a $7 Agent Assistance Fee is added under One-Time Charges. A late payment charge can still apply.
If service was suspended, paying the past-due balance usually restores it within an hour; otherwise call 1-800-VERIZON.

help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Pay in My Verizon under Home or Bills, or use Make a one-time payment from the sign-in menu. Scheduled payments are taken on the date you pick, and one-time payments process within 24 hours. You can cancel a same-day payment up to 2 times every 90 days.
Save a bank account with Online Banking (through Trustly), or use a debit or credit card. You can also pay by mail or in person; personal checks may be refused after returned payments.

help.title: Disconnect Fios service
paragraphs: Call 1-800-VERIZON (800-837-4966), Monday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM ET or Saturday 8 AM to 5 PM ET, or in My Verizon go to Settings & profile, select Disconnect, start a chat, type disconnect and ask to chat with a representative.

Return rented equipment within 30 days to avoid an unreturned equipment charge. Customers under contract may owe an early termination fee capped at $350 that drops by $15 each month. Auto Pay and paper-free billing stay on until the final payment, and credit balances can take up to 60 days to be returned. If you're away for 30 days to 9 months you can suspend service instead.

extra.intent: Using Verizon's Fios help pages, find what Verizon charges if a customer service representative sets up a payment arrangement by phone. Do not set up an arrangement or make a payment.

solution.text: A $7 Agent Assistance Fee applies; arrangements made online or through the automated system are free.

extra.intent: A customer has both Fios Internet and Fios TV. Using Verizon's help, find the monthly Auto Pay discount they could get with a bank account and paper-free billing. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: With both Fios Internet and Fios TV the Auto Pay discount is $20 per month.
